categories.title: Categories to scrape
categories.description: List of Sauto.cz vehicle categories to scrape. Leave empty to scrape all categories.

maxListings.title: Maximum listings per category
maxListings.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape per category. 0 or empty = unlimited: every listing (categories over the API's 10,000-result window are split into price bands). A cap takes the newest listings.

includeDetailedData.title: Include detailed data
includeDetailedData.description: Whether to scrape detailed information from individual listing API (full description, phone, equipment, VIN)

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Optional search term to filter listings (e.g. 'Skoda Octavia')

location.title: Location filter (region or district)
location.description: Optional region or district (kraj / okres), as SEO or Czech name: e.g. 'jihomoravsky-kraj', 'Jihomoravský kraj', 'praha', 'brno-mesto', 'Brno-venkov'. A value that is neither fails the run instead of scraping all of Czechia.

priceMin.title: Minimum price (CZK)
priceMin.description: Minimum price filter in Czech Koruna

priceMax.title: Maximum price (CZK)
priceMax.description: Maximum price filter in Czech Koruna

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Sauto.cz (Seznam) returns HTTP 404 to datacenter and non-Czech IPs, so this Actor needs a Czech residential proxy to work on the Apify platform. Defaults to Apify Proxy residential IPs located in Czechia.
